> Public issue: do not paste credentials, cookies, raw logs, private URLs/IPs, internal hostnames, customer data, or infrastructure details.

## Workload class

Briefly describe the workload category without naming private systems or endpoints.

## Current pain

Examples: repeated 403/429/451, expired proxy auth, unstable proxy pool, high requests-per-usable-result, or mixed response/proxy-health attribution.

## Sanitized baseline

If available, include aggregate counts only: success rate, requests per usable result, latency range, or rotation rate.

Do not attach production logs, HAR/PCAP captures, screenshots containing secrets, or raw headers.

## What would count as improvement?

Define the metric you want to improve.

## Authorization / responsible use

Confirm that you are authorized to run the workload and will respect applicable target policies, rate limits, and law.
